name: Mapbox
description: Maps, navigation and location API platform. Its documentation describes three kinds of access token: public (pk), secret (sk) and temporary (tk).
notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. Candidate credential families were enumerated from the provider's own documentation (sources docs-mapbox-com-f48329e191, docs-mapbox-com-283c99738b, docs-mapbox-com-c7bd0aa1ca, docs-mapbox-com-898fae45d0, read 2026-10-01); each is a family record whose research state says how far it has been researched.
